title: chore(frontend): update otel-js dependenices, migrate to sdk-trace
author: pichlermarc
body: # Changes The OTel JS SIG is planning an SDK 3.0 release around October 15, 2026. With 3.0, `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node`, `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base` and `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-web` will be consolidated into one shared `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace` package with a slightly different public API. This new package is already available in the 2.x line of packages, and allows a full replacement of the in the most recent version (`2.12.0`). This PR: - updates packages to `2.12.0` and latest experimental versions - introduces a dependency on `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace` - removes `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-node`, `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-base` and `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace-web` - updates SDK trace use to the new public interface of `@opentelemetry/sdk-trace` Screenshot of a trace (span generated in the browser using the new setup): ## Merge Requirements For new features contributions, please make sure you have completed the following essential items: * [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated to document new feature additions * Note: left out since this is not a new feature, just an internal change + dependency update. please let me know if this is needed, and I'll add one. * [x] Appropriate documentation updates in the [docs][] * ref: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry.io/pull/11998 * [ ] Appropriate Helm chart updates in the [helm-charts][] * Note: not applicable since the changes are contained to the image Maintainers will not merge until the above have been completed. If you're unsure which docs need to be changed ping the [@open-telemetry/demo-approvers](https://github.com/orgs/open-telemetry/teams/demo-approvers). [docs]: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/demo/ [helm-charts]: https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-helm-charts
